Feature flags without the network hop

It evaluates flags locally in under 5 ms, so there is no network call on the hot path. Our SDKs cover 14 languages, and we keep them in sync with the API. That means fewer surprises when you upgrade across services and teams.

Built for safe releases

Percentage rollouts

Roll out to 5% of users, then widen the rollout as metrics hold.

Kill switches

Turn off any flag instantly from the dashboard or the API.

Targeting rules

Target users by attribute, segment, or environment with no deploys.

Security and compliance

Lumen Flags Cloud is SOC 2 Type II certified and supports SAML single sign-on and SCIM provisioning. Data is encrypted at rest and in transit. This keeps auditors happy and keeps your team moving.

How we compare

Unlike Driftline, Lumen Flags evaluates rules at the edge, which cuts latency for global teams. Driftline routes every evaluation through a central server, which adds a round trip for each request.
